literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该研究表明,温度、降水和 EBLV-1 变异的分布之间存在显着关联,EBLV-1 病例受到 1 月至 2 月(冬季)温和气温和 7 月高温的影响。 [10.1017/s0950268826101812]
发现了严重违规行为,包括 监测 采样减少 80%、对城市走廊野狗种群管理不力以及对受害者的临床误诊。 [10.1038/s41598-026-65032-3]
冷冻电镜结构显示,P-CTD 通过三个界面与 pY-STAT1 四聚体结合,封闭输入 α5 和 DNA 结合所需的表面,并稳定四聚体状态。基于细胞的测定表明,不同的 P-CTD 表面有助于拮抗 I 型和 II 型干扰素信号传导。 [10.64898/2026.07.29.741124]
数据表明,狂犬病病毒 P 蛋白拮抗某些 ISG 和 IRepG(包括经典 抗病毒药物 基因)的 IFN 依赖性刺激和抑制,同时使大部分 IRG 不受影响,并且专门针对 STAT1/2 调节的 IRG,而不影响 MAP 激酶调节基因。 [10.64898/2026.07.30.737726]
研究发现,早在感染后第 8 天,脾脏中就存在抗狂犬病病毒 CD4 T 细胞的证据,并且在单克隆抗体治疗的小鼠中,该细胞群一直增加到感染后≥28 天;此外,与模拟治疗的小鼠相比,感染后第 14 天,mAb 治疗的小鼠大脑中观察到抗狂犬病病毒 CD4 T 细胞出现频率更高。 [10.1093/jimmun/vkag141.1615]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The study demonstrated a significant association between temperature, precipitation, and the distribution of EBLV-1 variants, with EBLV-1 cases influenced by mild temperatures during January-February (winter) and high temperatures during July. [10.1017/s0950268826101812]

Critical breaches were identified, including an 80% decrease in surveillance sampling, insufficient management of feral dog populations in urban corridors, and clinical misdiagnosis of the victim. [10.1038/s41598-026-65032-3]

Cryo-EM structures revealed that P-CTD binds to pY-STAT1 tetramers through three interfaces, occluding surfaces needed for importin α5 and DNA binding, and stabilizing the tetrameric state. Cell-based assays showed that different P-CTD surfaces contribute to the antagonism of type I and type II interferon signaling. [10.64898/2026.07.29.741124]

The data indicate that rabies virus P protein antagonizes both IFN-dependent stimulation and repression of certain ISGs and IRepGs, including classical antiviral genes, while leaving a large proportion of IRGs unaffected, and specifically targets STAT1/2-regulated IRGs without impacting MAP-kinase-regulated genes. [10.64898/2026.07.30.737726]

The study found evidence of anti-lyssavirus CD4 T-cells in the spleen as early as day 8 post-infection, with this population increasing until ≥28 days post-infection in mAb-treated mice; additionally, a higher frequency of anti-lyssavirus CD4 T-cells was observed in the brains of mAb-treated mice on day 14 post-infection compared to mock-treated mice. [10.1093/jimmun/vkag141.1615]

The study demonstrated a significant association between temperature, precipitation, and the distribution of EBLV-1 variants, with EBLV-1 cases influenced by mild temperatures during January-February (winter) and high temperatures during July. news.lead_zh: 近期美国多个州报告了狂犬病病例增加的情况,公共卫生部门已采取多种措施加强防控。
key_findings_zh: 佛罗里达州马里恩县发现浣熊狂犬病确诊病例,发布健康警告。

news.headline_en: Rabies Cases Rise in Multiple U.S. States, Public Health Measures Intensify.
news.lead_en: Recent reports indicate an increase in rabies cases across multiple U.S. states, prompting public health authorities to enhance prevention efforts.
key_findings_en: Marion County, Florida, issued a rabies advisory after a confirmed raccoon case.
Oregon matched its record for rabies-positive bats in 2026, with 22 confirmed cases.
Ohio reported 15 rabies-positive bats in 2026, with two counties confirming bat infections.
South Carolina has reported 66 rabies cases in 2026, including raccoons and bats.
Vermont plans an oral rabies vaccination campaign in August to curb wildlife transmission.
news.trend_or_risk_en: Rabies is on the rise in multiple states, with increased risk of transmission from wildlife.
news.caveats_en: Some reports lack specific event dates, and details on investigations are not fully disclosed.
news.brief_en: Multiple U.S. states have reported an increase in rabies cases, prompting public health authorities to issue advisories and implement prevention measures. These include vaccination campaigns, monitoring of wildlife, and public education on avoiding contact with bats and other animals.

papers.title: Bat rabies in France: Analysis of national surveillance data reveals contrasting bioclimatic preferences between EBLV-1a and EBLV-1b of the common serotine ( Cnephaeus (Eptesicus) serotinus ) bats
papers.abstract: Bat rabies in mainland France, as in the rest of Europe, is mainly caused by European bat lyssavirus 1 (EBLV-1; Lyssavirus hamburg), which is hosted almost exclusively by Cnephaeus (Eptesicus) serotinus, a bat species presents on the whole metropolitan France territory.Two distinct variants of EBLV-1, namely EBLV-1a and EBLV-1b, have been previously identified in mainland France and exhibit separate with a little overlap distributions, i.e. parapatric distributions.Because bats, and potentially the pathogens they harbour, are highly sensitive to climatic variability due to their physiological traits (including heterothermy), this study evaluates the influence of climatic conditions on the nationalscale geographical distribution of the two variants.Using generalized linear models (GLMs) and species distribution models (SDMs), we demonstrate a significant association between temperature, precipitation, and variant distribution.Among analysed samples, the occurrence of EBLV-1 cases was influenced by mild temperatures during January-February (winter), high temperatures during Julyhttps://

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the influence of climatic conditions on the national-scale geographical distribution of EBLV-1a and EBLV-1b variants in France, given their separate distributions and the sensitivity of bats to climatic variability.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used generalized linear models (GLMs) and species distribution models (SDMs) to analyze national surveillance data on bat rabies cases in mainland France, focusing on the common serotine bat (Cnephaeus (Eptesicus) serotinus).
analysis.methods: The analysis employed GLMs and SDMs to assess the association between temperature, precipitation, and the geographical distribution of EBLV-1a and EBLV-1b variants using national surveillance data.
analysis.main_results: The study demonstrated a significant association between temperature, precipitation, and the distribution of EBLV-1 variants, with EBLV-1 cases influenced by mild temperatures during January-February (winter) and high temperatures during July.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence of contrasting bioclimatic preferences between EBLV-1a and EBLV-1b, highlighting the role of climatic factors in shaping their geographical distributions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform rabies surveillance strategies by identifying climatic factors associated with variant distribution, aiding in targeted monitoring and prevention efforts in high-risk areas.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on observational data and models, which may not fully account for all ecological or confounding factors influencing variant distribution.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed national surveillance data on bat rabies in France to investigate the influence of climatic conditions on the geographical distribution of EBLV-1a and EBLV-1b variants, hosted by the common serotine bat. Using GLMs and SDMs, the researchers found a significant association between temperature, precipitation, and variant distribution, with EBLV-1 cases linked to mild winter temperatures and high July temperatures. The findings reveal contrasting bioclimatic preferences between the two variants, providing insights for targeted rabies surveillance and prevention strategies. The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on observational data and models.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估气候条件对法国 EBLV-1a 和 EBLV-1b 变种的全国范围地理分布的影响,考虑到它们的独立分布以及蝙蝠对气候变化的敏感性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用广义线性模型(GLM)和物种分布模型(SDM)来分析法国大陆蝙蝠 狂犬病 病例的国家 监测 数据,重点关注常见的血清蝙蝠(Cnephaeus (Eptesicus) serotinus)。
elements_zh.methods: 该分析采用 GLM 和 SDM,利用国家 监测 数据评估温度、降水以及 EBLV-1a 和 EBLV-1b 变体的地理分布之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究表明,温度、降水和 EBLV-1 变异的分布之间存在显着关联,EBLV-1 病例受到 1 月至 2 月(冬季)温和气温和 7 月高温的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 EBLV-1a 和 EBLV-1b 之间生物气候偏好对比的证据,强调了气候因素在塑造其地理分布中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过识别与变异分布相关的气候因素来为 狂犬病 监测 策略提供信息,帮助在高风险地区进行有针对性的监测和预防工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于观察数据和模型,这可能无法完全解释影响变异分布的所有生态或混杂因素。

papers.title: Rabies virus antagonizes interferon signaling by targeting phosphorylated STAT1 tetramers
papers.abstract: Rabies virus phosphoprotein (P protein) antagonizes interferon signalling by selectively targeting activated STAT1 protein, but the structural basis for the selective recognition of activated STAT1 has remained unclear. Here we report cryo-EM structures of tyrosine-phosphorylated STAT1 (pY-STAT1) in complex with the C-terminal domain of P protein (P-CTD). P-CTD engages the pY-STAT1 tetramer through three discrete interfaces, contacting two DNA-binding domains within a pY-mediated STAT1 dimer and the N-terminal domain of a third STAT1 protomer. This binding mode explains how P-CTD selectively recognizes activated STAT1, occludes surfaces required for importin α5 and DNA binding, and stabilizes the compact tetrameric state, thereby restricting the conformational transition required for cooperative DNA binding. Cell-based assays further indicate that distinct P-CTD surfaces differentially contribute to antagonism of type I and type II interferon signalling. Further, by acting as an anchoring molecule, P-CTD also enabled structural elucidation of the complete STAT1 structures in the tetramer. Together, these data reveal critical mechanisms in viral immune evasion and pathogenesis, and fundamental innate immune signaling.

analysis.methods: The researchers used cryo-EM to determine the structures of pY-STAT1 in complex with the C-terminal domain of the P protein (P-CTD), and performed cell-based assays to assess the contribution of distinct P-CTD surfaces to interferon signaling antagonism.
analysis.main_results: Cryo-EM structures revealed that P-CTD binds to pY-STAT1 tetramers through three interfaces, occluding surfaces needed for importin α5 and DNA binding, and stabilizing the tetrameric state. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a structural explanation for how P-CTD selectively inhibits activated STAT1, thereby blocking interferon signaling, and highlight the role of P-CTD as an anchoring molecule for structural elucidation of STAT1 tetramers.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results advance understanding of rabies virus immune evasion mechanisms, which could inform the development of targeted antiviral therapies and improve strategies for vaccine design and disease prevention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to structural and cell-based assays, with no clinical or epidemiological data provided. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在阐明狂犬病病毒磷蛋白(P蛋白)如何选择性识别激活的STAT1以拮抗干扰素信号传导的结构基础,填补理解病毒免疫逃避分子机制的空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用冷冻电镜对 狂犬病病毒 P-CTD 与酪氨酸磷酸化 STAT1 (pY-STAT1) 复合物进行结构分析,该分析是在没有提及特定人群或 宿主 的实验室环境中进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用冷冻电镜确定了 pY-STAT1 与 P 蛋白 C 端结构域 (P-CTD) 复合物的结构,并进行了基于细胞的测定,以评估不同 P-CTD 表面对干扰素信号传导拮抗作用的贡献。
elements_zh.main_results: 冷冻电镜结构显示,P-CTD 通过三个界面与 pY-STAT1 四聚体结合,封闭输入 α5 和 DNA 结合所需的表面,并稳定四聚体状态。基于细胞的测定表明,不同的 P-CTD 表面有助于拮抗 I 型和 II 型干扰素信号传导。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为 P-CTD 如何选择性抑制激活的 STAT1 从而阻断干扰素信号传导提供了结构解释,并强调了 P-CTD 作为锚定分子在 STAT1 四聚体结构阐明中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果促进了对 疫苗 免疫逃避机制的理解,这可以为靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发提供信息,并改进 疫苗 设计和疾病预防的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于结构和基于细胞的测定,未提供临床或流行病学数据。结构见解的证据很充分,但缺乏直接的生物学或临床验证,导致可信度评估适中。

papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病病毒磷蛋白(P蛋白)通过选择性靶向激活的STAT1蛋白来拮抗干扰素信号传导,但选择性识别激活的STAT1的结构基础仍不清楚。在这里,我们报道了酪氨酸磷酸化 STAT1 (pY-STAT1) 与 P 蛋白 C 端结构域 (P-CTD) 复合物的冷冻电镜结构。P-CTD 通过三个离散的界面接合 pY-STAT1 四聚体,接触 pY 介导的 STAT1 二聚体内的两个 DNA 结合域和第三个 STAT1 原聚体的 N 端结构域。这种结合模式解释了P-CTD如何选择性地识别激活的STAT1,封闭输入α5和DNA结合所需的表面,并稳定紧凑的四聚体状态,从而限制合作DNA结合所需的构象转变。基于细胞的测定进一步表明,不同的 P-CTD 表面对 I 型和 II 型干扰素信号传导的拮抗作用不同。此外,通过充当锚定分子,P-CTD 还能够阐明四聚体中完整的 STAT1 结构。这些数据共同揭示了病毒免疫逃避和 发病机制 的关键机制,以及基本的先天免疫信号传导。

papers.title: A one health analysis of the reemergence of dog-mediated human rabies in Peru
papers.abstract: Abstract The 2023 reemergence of dog-mediated human rabies in Arequipa, Peru, after nearly a decade of absence, represents a critical failure in public health systems. Despite regional progress toward the “Zero by 30” strategy, this human rabies case highlights persistent systemic vulnerabilities. Here we investigate how this preventable death emerged, by integrating epidemiologic, socioecological, and policy data through a One Health lens. Using the Swiss cheese model, we identified multiple defensive layers—policies, outbreak response, system capacity building, and socio-geographical features—that aligned to permit transmission. We identified critical breaches, such as an 80% decrease in surveillance sampling, insufficient management of feral dog populations in urban corridors, and clinical misdiagnosis of the victim. These findings suggest that rabies persists not for lack of tools, but due to fragmented application and institutional amnesia. We propose a redesigned multisectoral framework to transform human rabies from a neglected tragedy into a true “never event”.

papers.title: Monoclonal antibody therapy augments production of virus-specific CD4 T cells during Australian bat lyssavirus infection of the CNS 2309800
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Developing therapeutic countermeasures that can target pathogens within the central nervous system (CNS) remains a challenging task. Rabies virus and other lyssaviruses are well-known examples of neurotropic pathogens that can efficiently evade both the host immune response and current therapeutic strategies. Australian bat lyssavirus (ABLV) is a member of the lyssavirus genus and is known to causes disease that is indistinguishable from rabies. Rabies is uniformly fatal once the infection has entered the CNS, and there is currently no effective treatment post-CNS involvement. Previously, our group demonstrated that a single dose of monoclonal antibody (mAb) treatment can prevent mortality even in mice with established CNS infections, and mAb-mediated survival was CD4 T-cell dependent. To investigate the mechanism of enhancement of the host adaptive immune response, we have developed tools to assess the dynamics of virus-specific CD4 T-cells produced in ABLV-infected mice. Methods Using a novel anti-lyssavirus MHC II tetramer, we quantified virus-specific CD4 T-cell responses in the spleens and brains of infected mice that received mock- or mAb-treatment. Results We found evidence of anti-lyssavirus CD4 T-cells in the spleen as early as day 8 post-infection in infected animals, and this population increased until ≥28 days post-infection in infected mAb-treated mice. We also found a higher frequency of anti-lyssavirus CD4 T-cells in the brains of infected mAb-treated mice on day 14 post-infection, when compared to infected, mock-treated mice. Interestingly, although there were fewer ABLV-specific T-cells in the mock-treated animals, these T-cells produced much more IFN-γ than the T-cells isolated from mAb-treated mice. Conclusion Collectively, our data suggests that mAb treatment can alter the T-cell response by augmenting the generation of virus-specific CD4 T-cells and by modulating effector cytokine production by these T-cells. Department of Defense Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how monoclonal antibody therapy enhances the host immune response during Australian bat lyssavirus (ABLV) infection of the central nervous system (CNS). Using a mouse model and a novel anti-lyssavirus MHC II tetramer, the researchers found that mAb treatment significantly increased the production of virus-specific CD4 T-cells in both the spleen and brain compared to mock-treated controls. The T-cells in mAb-treated mice showed higher frequencies but lower IFN-γ production compared to mock-treated animals. These findings could inform the development of post-exposure treatments for rabies and related viral encephalitis.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 开发针对中枢神经系统 (CNS) 内病原体的治疗对策仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。狂犬病病毒 和其他狂犬病病毒是众所周知的嗜神经病原体的例子,它们可以有效地逃避 宿主 免疫应答 和当前的治疗策略。澳大利亚蝙蝠狂犬病毒 (ABLV) 是狂犬病病毒属的成员,已知其引起的疾病与 狂犬病 没有区别。一旦感染进入中枢神经系统,狂犬病 都是致命的,目前尚无有效的 治疗 后中枢神经系统受累。此前,我们的研究小组证明,单剂量的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 治疗 即使在已确诊中枢神经系统感染的小鼠中也能预防 死亡率,并且 mAb 介导的生存依赖于 CD4 T 细胞。为了研究 宿主 适应性 免疫应答 的增强机制,我们开发了工具来评估 ABLV 感染小鼠中产生的病毒特异性 CD4 T 细胞的动态。方法 使用新型抗狂犬病病毒 MHC II 四聚体,我们对接受模拟或 mAb-治疗 的感染小鼠的脾脏和大脑中的病毒特异性 CD4 T 细胞反应进行了定量。结果我们早在受感染动物感染后第 8 天就在脾脏中发现了抗狂犬病病毒 CD4 T 细胞的证据,并且在受感染 mAb 治疗的小鼠中,该细胞群一直增加到感染后≥28 天。我们还发现,与感染的、模拟治疗的小鼠相比,感染后第 14 天,感染的 mAb 治疗小鼠的大脑中抗狂犬病病毒 CD4 T 细胞的出现频率更高。有趣的是,尽管模拟治疗的动物中 ABLV 特异性 T 细胞较少,但这些 T 细胞产生的 IFN-γ 比从 mAb 治疗的小鼠中分离的 T 细胞要多得多。结论 总的来说,我们的数据表明 mAb 治疗 可以通过增加病毒特异性 CD4 T 细胞的生成并调节这些 T 细胞产生效应细胞因子来改变 T 细胞反应。国防部主题类别 疫苗 和免疫治疗 (VAC)

papers.title: Monoclonal antibody therapy promotes survival by recalibrating neuroinflammation during Australian Bat Lyssavirus Infection 2308563
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Australian Bat Lyssavirus (ABLV), a neurotropic relative of Rabies virus, causes fatal encephalitis. Effective treatment for symptomatic infections remains elusive. Our prior work showed that an anti-ABLV monoclonal antibody (mAb) F11 or A6 can prevent disease even after the establishment of central nervous system (CNS) infection. Survival requires CD4 T cell-dependent immunity. mAb therapy alters CNS leukocyte composition, suggesting mAb-driven immune restructuring. The precise mechanism of protection is unclear; specifically, whether mAb protection results from enhancing overall immunity or from moderating inflammation. We hypothesized that F11 or A6 therapy promotes survival by recalibrating, rather than enhancing, CNS immune activation. Methods Mice were infected with a lethal dose of ABLV in the rear footpad. On day 5 post-infection, mice received mAb (F11 or A6), an isotype control mAb, or mock treatment. Brain tissue was analyzed on day 13 or 14 post-infection using multiplex cytokine assays, bulk RNA sequencing, and flow cytometry to compare immune signatures across treatment groups. Results Mock-treated mice showed elevated levels of inflammatory cytokines, type I/II interferons, and chemokines associated with myeloid, NK, and T cell recruitment, with transcriptomic enrichment for neuroinflammation and interferon/STAT pathways. In contrast, F11 or A6 therapy produced distinct transcriptional signatures marked by coordinated downregulation of inflammatory pathways and reduced cytokine and chemokine expression. Despite reduced inflammation, treated mice displayed increased numbers of CD11b+MHCII+ myeloid cells and a higher CD4:CD8 T cell ratio. Conclusion Therapy with F11 or A6 dampens interferon-driven inflammation while promoting balanced immunity in the CNS. Survival correlates with reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression and altered phenotypes of infiltrating immune cells, suggesting that excessive inflammation is detrimental to survival during ABLV infection. Funding Source US Department of Defense Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.research_question_and_background: Australian Bat Lyssavirus (ABLV), a neurotropic relative of Rabies virus, causes fatal encephalitis, and effective treatment for symptomatic infections remains elusive.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Mice were infected with a lethal dose of ABLV in the rear footpad, and on day 5 post-infection, mice received mAb (F11 or A6), an isotype control mAb, or mock treatment.
analysis.methods: Brain tissue was analyzed on day 13 or 14 post-infection using multiplex cytokine assays, bulk RNA sequencing, and flow cytometry to compare immune signatures across treatment groups.
analysis.main_results: Mock-treated mice showed elevated levels of inflammatory cytokines, type I/II interferons, and chemokines associated with myeloid, NK, and T cell recruitment, with transcriptomic enrichment for neuroinflammation and interferon/STAT pathways; in contrast, F11 or A6 therapy produced distinct transcriptional signatures marked by coordinated downregulation of inflammatory pathways and reduced cytokine and chemokine expression.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Therapy with F11 or A6 dampens interferon-driven inflammation while promoting balanced immunity in the CNS, and survival correlates with reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression and altered phenotypes of infiltrating immune cells.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that excessive inflammation is detrimental to survival during ABLV infection, and monoclonal antibody therapy may offer a promising approach by recalibrating neuroinflammation rather than simply enhancing overall immunity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in a mouse model, and the precise mechanism of protection, whether mAb protection results from enhancing overall immunity or from moderating inflammation, remains unclear; however, the evidence strength is high due to the use of multiple complementary methods and clear comparative analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the mechanism by which monoclonal antibody (mAb) therapy promotes survival during Australian Bat Lyssavirus (ABLV) infection, a neurotropic relative of Rabies virus. The researchers hypothesized that mAb therapy recalibrates, rather than enhances, CNS immune activation. Using a mouse model infected with a lethal dose of ABLV, they administered mAb (F11 or A6), an isotype control, or mock treatment on day 5 post-infection. Brain tissue analysis on day 13 or 14 revealed that mock-treated mice exhibited elevated inflammatory cytokines, interferons, and chemokines, with transcriptomic enrichment for neuroinflammation pathways. In contrast, mAb therapy downregulated inflammatory pathways while increasing CD11b+MHCII+ myeloid cells and the CD4:CD8 T cell ratio. The findings indicate that mAb therapy dampens interferon-driven inflammation and promotes balanced immunity, suggesting that excessive inflammation is detrimental to survival. This research provides insights into the therapeutic potential of mAb therapy for ABLV and related lyssaviruses by targeting neuroinflammation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 澳大利亚蝙蝠狂犬病毒 (ABLV) 是 狂犬病病毒 的嗜神经亲缘病毒,可引起致命性脑炎,而有效治疗症状感染的 治疗 仍然难以捉摸。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 小鼠后足垫感染致死剂量的 ABLV,感染后第 5 天,小鼠接受 mAb(F11 或 A6)、同种型对照 mAb 或模拟 治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 在感染后第 13 或 14 天,使用多重细胞因子测定、批量 RNA 测序和流式细胞术对脑组织进行分析,以比较 治疗 组之间的免疫特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 模拟治疗小鼠的炎症细胞因子、I/II 型干扰素以及与骨髓、NK 和 T 细胞募集相关的趋化因子水平升高,神经炎症和干扰素/STAT 通路的转录组富集;相比之下,F11 或 A6 疗法产生了独特的转录特征,其特征是炎症途径的协调下调以及细胞因子和趋化因子表达的减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: F11 或 A6 治疗可抑制干扰素驱动的炎症,同时促进中枢神经系统的平衡免疫,并且生存与促炎细胞因子表达减少和浸润免疫细胞表型改变相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,ABLV 感染期间过度炎症不利于生存,单克隆抗体疗法可能通过重新调整神经炎症而不是简单地增强整体免疫力来提供一种有前景的方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在小鼠模型中进行的,具体的保护机制(mAb 保护是来自增强整体免疫力还是来自减轻炎症)仍不清楚;然而,由于使用了多种互补方法和清晰的比较分析,证据强度很高。

papers.title: The rabies virus interferon antagonist P protein selectively modulates interferon signalling to inhibit antiviral gene expression while supporting proviral gene expression
papers.abstract: Type-I IFNs mediate the principle antiviral response of cells by controlling the expression of hundreds of IFN-regulated genes (IRGs), many of which have antiviral functions. The best understood mediators of IFN signalling are STAT1 and STAT2, and STAT1/2-dependent gene induction is conventionally viewed as the primary outcome of type-I IFN signalling. To overcome the IFN response, viruses express proteins called IFN-antagonists, which target IFN signalling pathways (e.g. rabies virus P-protein (RABV-P) binds and inhibits IFN-activated STAT1/2) and so are typically considered to mediate shutdown of the IFN response. However, IFN signalling is not exclusively antiviral, with many IRGs reported to be required for or to facilitate infection by certain viruses. How viruses coordinate the apparent need to suppress certain antiviral IRGs, while presumably permitting the expression of others, including proviral IRGs is poorly defined. However, it has been shown that type-I IFN can activate multiple pathways other than classical STAT1/2, so discriminatory targeting of specific pathways by IFN-antagonists may enable highly selective regulation of distinct IRGs, dependent on the requirements of the specific virus. Here, we analyse the global effects of RABV-P protein on the IFN-regulated transcriptome. We confirm that IFN not only stimulates (IFN-stimulated genes, ISGs) but also represses (IFN-repressed genes, IRepGs) a large number of IRGs. Notably, our data indicate that RABV-P protein can antagonize both the IFN-dependent stimulation and repression of certain ISGs and IRepGs, without significantly impacting the expression of large proportion of IRGs. Antagonized ISGs included classical antiviral genes, while non-antagonized ISGs include genes with pro-viral effects on RABV. Transcription factor analysis indicated that RABV-P antagonizes STAT1/2-regulated IRGs, but not IRGs regulated by other pathways including MAP-kinase pathways, which are important to process such as cell survival and inflammatory response. These data indicate that selective modulation rather than global inhibition of IFN-signalling has beneficial outcomes for replication. The data also support the significance of IRepGs, and their modulation by IFN antagonists in viral infection.

analysis.methods: Transcription factor analysis was performed to identify pathways regulated by rabies virus P protein, focusing on STAT1/2-dependent and alternative pathways such as MAP-kinase pathways, to assess selective antagonism of specific IRGs.
analysis.main_results: The data indicate that rabies virus P protein antagonizes both IFN-dependent stimulation and repression of certain ISGs and IRepGs, including classical antiviral genes, while leaving a large proportion of IRGs unaffected, and specifically targets STAT1/2-regulated IRGs without impacting MAP-kinase-regulated genes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that selective modulation rather than global inhibition of IFN-signalling has beneficial outcomes for viral replication, highlighting the significance of IRepGs and their modulation by IFN antagonists in viral infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform understanding of viral immune evasion strategies, potentially guiding the development of targeted antiviral therapies that disrupt selective interferon modulation by rabies virus and related lyssaviruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study provides mechanistic insights into selective IFN modulation by rabies virus P protein but is limited to transcriptome analysis without direct functional validation of individual IRGs in viral replication.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how rabies virus P protein selectively modulates interferon signalling to inhibit antiviral gene expression while supporting proviral gene expression. The researchers analysed the global effects of RABV-P on the IFN-regulated transcriptome, confirming that IFN both stimulates and represses numerous genes. They found that RABV-P antagonizes specific ISGs and IRepGs, including classical antiviral genes, while leaving many IRGs unaffected, and selectively targets STAT1/2-regulated pathways without impacting MAP-kinase pathways. The authors conclude that selective modulation, rather than global inhibition, of IFN-signalling benefits viral replication, emphasizing the importance of IRepGs in viral infection. These findings advance understanding of viral immune evasion and may inform targeted antiviral strategies against rabies and related lyssaviruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解狂犬病病毒 P蛋白如何选择性调节干扰素信号传导以抑制抗病毒药物基因表达,同时支持原病毒基因表达,解决病毒协调抑制某些抗病毒药物干扰素调节基因(IRG)同时允许其他基因表达的尚不明确的机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 狂犬病病毒 P 蛋白对 IFN 调节转录组的整体影响,检查 IFN 刺激基因 (ISG) 和 IFN 抑制基因 (IRepGs),以确定干扰素信号通路的选择性调节。
elements_zh.methods: 进行转录因子分析以鉴定 狂犬病病毒 P 蛋白调节的途径,重点关注 STAT1/2 依赖性途径和替代途径(如 MAP 激酶途径),以评估特定 IRG 的选择性拮抗作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 数据表明,狂犬病病毒 P 蛋白拮抗某些 ISG 和 IRepG(包括经典 抗病毒药物 基因)的 IFN 依赖性刺激和抑制,同时使大部分 IRG 不受影响,并且专门针对 STAT1/2 调节的 IRG,而不影响 MAP 激酶调节基因。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,IFN 信号传导的选择性调节而不是全局抑制对病毒复制具有有益的结果,强调了 IRepG 及其 IFN 拮抗剂在病毒感染中的调节的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解病毒免疫逃避策略,可能指导开发靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法,破坏 狂犬病病毒 和相关狂犬病病毒的选择性干扰素调节。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究提供了 狂犬病病毒 P 蛋白选择性 IFN 调节的机制见解,但仅限于转录组分析,没有对病毒复制中的单个 IRG 进行直接功能验证。

papers.title_zh: 狂犬病病毒 干扰素拮抗剂 P 蛋白选择性调节干扰素信号传导,抑制 抗病毒药物 基因表达,同时支持原病毒基因表达
papers.source_body_en: Type-I IFNs mediate the principle antiviral response of cells by controlling the expression of hundreds of IFN-regulated genes (IRGs), many of which have antiviral functions. The best understood mediators of IFN signalling are STAT1 and STAT2, and STAT1/2-dependent gene induction is conventionally viewed as the primary outcome of type-I IFN signalling. To overcome the IFN response, viruses express proteins called IFN-antagonists, which target IFN signalling pathways (e.g. rabies virus P-protein (RABV-P) binds and inhibits IFN-activated STAT1/2) and so are typically considered to mediate shutdown of the IFN response. However, IFN signalling is not exclusively antiviral, with many IRGs reported to be required for or to facilitate infection by certain viruses. How viruses coordinate the apparent need to suppress certain antiviral IRGs, while presumably permitting the expression of others, including proviral IRGs is poorly defined. However, it has been shown that type-I IFN can activate multiple pathways other than classical STAT1/2, so discriminatory targeting of specific pathways by IFN-antagonists may enable highly selective regulation of distinct IRGs, dependent on the requirements of the specific virus. Here, we analyse the global effects of RABV-P protein on the IFN-regulated transcriptome. We confirm that IFN not only stimulates (IFN-stimulated genes, ISGs) but also represses (IFN-repressed genes, IRepGs) a large number of IRGs. Notably, our data indicate that RABV-P protein can antagonize both the IFN-dependent stimulation and repression of certain ISGs and IRepGs, without significantly impacting the expression of large proportion of IRGs. Antagonized ISGs included classical antiviral genes, while non-antagonized ISGs include genes with pro-viral effects on RABV. Transcription factor analysis indicated that RABV-P antagonizes STAT1/2-regulated IRGs, but not IRGs regulated by other pathways including MAP-kinase pathways, which are important to process such as cell survival and inflammatory response. These data indicate that selective modulation rather than global inhibition of IFN-signalling has beneficial outcomes for replication. The data also support the significance of IRepGs, and their modulation by IFN antagonists in viral infection.
papers.abstract_zh: I 型 IFN 通过控制数百个 IFN 调节基因 (IRG) 的表达来介导细胞的主要 抗病毒药物 反应,其中许多基因具有 抗病毒药物 功能。最了解的 IFN 信号传导介质是 STAT1 和 STAT2,STAT1/2 依赖性基因诱导通常被视为 I 型 IFN 信号传导的主要结果。为了克服 IFN 反应,病毒表达称为 IFN 拮抗剂的蛋白质,该蛋白质针对 IFN 信号通路(例如 狂犬病病毒 P 蛋白 (RABV-P) 结合并抑制 IFN 激活的 STAT1/2),因此通常被认为可以介导 IFN 反应的关闭。然而,IFN 信号传导并不完全是 抗病毒药物,据报道许多 IRG 是某些病毒感染所必需的或促进某些病毒的感染。病毒如何协调抑制某些 抗病毒药物 IRGs 的明显需要,同时可能允许其他 IRGs(包括原病毒 IRGs)的表达尚不清楚。然而,已经表明,I 型 IFN 可以激活除经典 STAT1/2 之外的多种途径,因此 IFN 拮抗剂对特定途径的区别性靶向可能能够根据特定病毒的需求,实现对不同 IRG 的高度选择性调节。在这里,我们分析了 RABV-P 蛋白对 IFN 调节的转录组的整体影响。我们证实IFN不仅刺激(IFN刺激基因,ISG)而且抑制(IFN抑制基因,IRepG)大量IRG。值得注意的是,我们的数据表明,RABV-P 蛋白可以拮抗某些 ISG 和 IRepG 的 IFN 依赖性刺激和抑制,而不显着影响大部分 IRG 的表达。拮抗的ISG包括经典的抗病毒药物基因,而非拮抗的ISG包括对RABV具有促病毒作用的基因。转录因子分析表明,RABV-P 拮抗 STAT1/2 调节的 IRG,但不拮抗其他途径(包括 MAP 激酶途径)调节的 IRG,这些途径对细胞存活和炎症反应等过程很重要。这些数据表明选择性调节而不是全局抑制 IFN 信号对复制具有有益的结果。这些数据还支持 IRepG 的重要性以及 IFN 拮抗剂在病毒感染中对其的调节。

papers.title: Rabies, Coronavirus, and Hantavirus Surveillance in Bats From the Atlantic Forest of Northeastern Argentina
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bats are increasingly recognized as reservoirs of numerous emerging and re‐emerging zoonotic pathogens. However, little is known about the distribution of most hosts and viruses and the role of each bat species in transmission, particularly in South America. This study screened for orthohantavirus, rabies, and coronavirus infection, and characterized bat communities from Misiones Province, Argentina, during 2022–2025. At least 14 bat species were captured 1214 times. Blood samples were tested for orthohantavirus‐specific antibodies by ELISA. Buccopharyngeal swabs were screened by two separate real‐time RT‐PCR assays: a pan‐lyssavirus assay and a pan‐coronavirus assay. Lyssavirus rabies RNA was detected in two individuals ( Sturnira lilium and Artibeus lituratus ), representing the first confirmed record in S. lilium in Argentina. Coronavirus RNA was detected in two Sturnira lilium , one Carollia perspicillata , and one Artibeus lituratus . Two of these samples, corresponding to C. perspicillata and A. lituratus , were successfully characterized as Alphacoronavirus . No antibodies against orthohantavirus were detected. These findings confirm high bat diversity and viral circulation in frugivorous bats, supporting integrated surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the presence of rabies virus and other zoonotic pathogens in bat populations from the Atlantic Forest in northeastern Argentina. It captured at least 14 bat species 1214 times between 2022 and 2025, testing blood samples for orthohantavirus antibodies and buccopharyngeal swabs for rabies and coronavirus RNA. Rabies virus was detected in two bat species, Sturnira lilium and Artibeus lituratus, marking the first confirmed record in S. lilium in Argentina. Coronavirus RNA was found in multiple species, while no orthohantavirus antibodies were detected. The study supports the need for integrated surveillance of rabies virus in frugivorous bats, contributing to public health efforts in the region. However, the findings are limited to a specific geographic area and bat species, suggesting a moderate confidence level in their generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查阿根廷东北部大西洋森林蝙蝠种群中 狂犬病病毒 和其他人畜共患病原体的存在,因为蝙蝠越来越多地被认为是众多新出现和重新出现的人畜共患病原体的 储存宿主。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于2022年至2025年在阿根廷米西奥内斯省进行,捕获至少14种蝙蝠1214次,以筛查正汉坦病毒、狂犬病和冠状病毒感染。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 检测血液样本中的正汉坦病毒特异性抗体,同时使用两种实时 RT-PCR 检测方法对颊咽拭子进行分析:泛狂犬病病毒检测和泛冠状病毒检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 在两个个体(Sturnira lilium 和 Artibeus lituratus)中检测到狂犬病病毒 狂犬病 RNA,这是阿根廷百合花中首次确认的记录。在两种百合花、一种卡罗利亚百合花和一种斜纹草中检测到了冠状病毒 RNA。未检测到针对正汉坦病毒的抗体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果证实了特定蝙蝠物种中存在 狂犬病病毒,强调需要整合 监测 来监测食果蝙蝠中的病毒循环。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于了解 狂犬病病毒 在蝙蝠种群中的分布,这对于制定该地区有针对性的 狂犬病病毒 和预防策略至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究提供了特定地理区域和蝙蝠物种中病毒存在的概况,由于范围和区域变异的可能性有限,因此具有中等置信度。

papers.title: Emergence of Rabies in Cape Fur Seals, South Africa
papers.abstract: Rabies was diagnosed in Cape fur seals by using direct fluorescent antibody testing in South Africa, 2024. We investigated the origin of rabies virus in this species. Phylogenetic analysis revealed virus introduction from jackals into seals, followed by sustained viral transmission within the seal population and spillover into a domestic dog.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the emergence of rabies in Cape fur seals in South Africa, diagnosed in 2024. Through phylogenetic analysis, the researchers traced the virus origin to jackals, followed by sustained transmission within the seal population and spillover into a domestic dog. This novel zoonotic pathway underscores the importance of surveillance in marine mammals and potential risks to terrestrial species and humans. The evidence, though limited to a single outbreak, is strengthened by robust phylogenetic data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究调查了南非海狗 狂犬病病毒 的起源,狂犬病 于 2024 年在南非被诊断出来。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及南非海豹,它们于 2024 年被诊断出患有 狂犬病,并包括系统发育分析以追踪病毒起源。
elements_zh.methods: 进行系统发育分析以确定海豹种群中 传播 的起源和 传播 动态。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析表明,狂犬病病毒 是从豺狼引入海豹的,随后是海豹种群中持续存在的 传播,以及家犬中的 跨物种溢出。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明了一种新的人畜共患 传播 途径,其中 狂犬病病毒 适应了新的海洋 宿主 并溢出回陆地物种。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这凸显了增强海洋哺乳动物 监测 的必要性以及对该地区家畜和人类的潜在风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于单个 暴发 和有限的样本量,但系统发育分析为 传播 通路提供了强有力的支持。

papers.title: Mitigating Cancer Therapy-Related Cognitive Impairment by Targeted Activation of Undruggable Phosphatase.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Cancer therapy‐related cognitive impairment (CTRCI) is a debilitating neurotoxic condition adversely impacting cancer patients during and post‐cancer treatments. The cancer treatments linked to CTRCI include chemotherapy, hormone therapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy. Despite CTRCI severely affecting the psychological and social, cognitive functions, and the overall quality of life of cancer survivors, no effective medications are available currently. Our prior studies have indicated hippocampal tyrosine phosphatase protein tyrosine phosphatase receptor type O (PTPRO) as a putative target for CTRCI. However, phosphatase is historically considered undruggable, and delivering drugs across the blood‐brain barrier (BBB) is challenging. Here, we developed a novel delivery system using neuron‐targeted extracellular vesicles (EVs) engineered with a neuron‐specific peptide rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG) to transport a small activating RNA (saRNA) targeting Ptpro (RVG‐EVs‐saPtpro). We evaluated the stability, dynamic distribution, cytotoxicity, and brain specificity of RVG‐EVs‐saPtpro in cellular and animal models. A single intravenous injection of RVG‐EVs‐saPtpro resulted in sustained elevation of PTPRO in the brain for at least 28 days in CTRCI mice. More importantly, RVG‐EVs‐saPtpro significantly alleviated CTRCI symptoms by enhancing neuronal survival, neurogenesis, and synaptic plasticity. These findings highlight the potential of RVG‐EVs‐saPtpro system for targeted treatment of CTRCI.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Cancer therapy-related cognitive impairment (CTRCI) is a debilitating neurotoxic condition affecting cancer patients during and post-treatments, with no effective medications currently available.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated a novel delivery system using neuron-targeted extracellular vesicles engineered with a rabies virus glycoprotein peptide in cellular and animal models.
analysis.methods: Researchers developed RVG-EVs-saPtpro, a small activating RNA targeting Ptpro delivered via neuron-specific peptide rabies virus glycoprotein-engineered extracellular vesicles, and assessed its stability, distribution, cytotoxicity, and brain specificity.
analysis.main_results: A single intravenous injection of RVG-EVs-saPtpro resulted in sustained elevation of PTPRO in the brain for at least 28 days in CTRCI mice and significantly alleviated CTRCI symptoms by enhancing neuronal survival, neurogenesis, and synaptic plasticity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the potential of the RVG-EVs-saPtpro system for targeted treatment of CTRCI, addressing the challenge of delivering drugs across the blood-brain barrier to target the undruggable phosphatase PTPRO.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This approach offers a promising therapeutic strategy for CTRCI, potentially improving the quality of life for cancer survivors by mitigating cognitive impairment through targeted activation of hippocampal tyrosine phosphatase PTPRO.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study was conducted in cellular and animal models, and further research is needed to evaluate the safety and efficacy in human patients.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses cancer therapy-related cognitive impairment (CTRCI), a debilitating condition with no current treatments. Researchers developed a novel delivery system using neuron-targeted extracellular vesicles engineered with rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG-EVs-saPtpro) to target the undruggable phosphatase PTPRO. In CTRCI mice, a single injection sustained PTPRO elevation for 28 days and significantly improved cognitive symptoms by enhancing neuronal survival, neurogenesis, and synaptic plasticity. This approach offers a promising therapeutic strategy for CTRCI, potentially improving cancer survivors' quality of life, though further human studies are needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 癌症治疗相关认知障碍 (CTRCI) 是一种使人衰弱的神经毒性病症,影响 治疗 期间和之后的癌症患者,目前尚无有效药物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在细胞和动物模型中评估了一种使用 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白肽设计的神经元靶向细胞外囊泡的新型递送系统。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员开发了 RVG-EVs-saPtpro,这是一种靶向 Ptpro 的小激活 RNA,通过神经元特异性肽 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白工程化的细胞外囊泡传递,并评估了其稳定性、分布、细胞毒性和脑特异性。
elements_zh.main_results: 单次静脉注射 RVG-EVs-saPtpro 导致 CTRCI 小鼠大脑中 PTPRO 持续升高至少 28 天,并通过增强神经元存活、神经发生和突触可塑性来显着缓解 CTRCI 症状。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果凸显了 RVG-EVs-saPtpro 系统对于 CTRCI 靶向 治疗 的潜力,解决了跨血脑屏障输送药物以靶向不可成药磷酸酶 PTPRO 的挑战。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这种方法为 CTRCI 提供了一种有前途的治疗策略,通过有针对性地激活海马酪氨酸磷酸酶 PTPRO 减轻认知障碍,有可能改善癌症幸存者的生活质量。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究是在细胞和动物模型中进行的,需要进一步的研究来评估人类患者的安全性和有效性。

papers.title: Spatial and Temporal Analysis of Rabies Cases in Rabies-Carrier Animals in Banjarbaru City
papers.abstract: Rabies remains one of the most dangerous zoonotic diseases due to its high fatality rate and ability to spread from rabies-transmitting animals to humans. The persistence of rabies cases is influenced by various factors, including the population density of rabies-infected animals, vaccination coverage, and the effectiveness of disease control programs. This study aimed to analyze the spatial and temporal distribution patterns of rabies cases among rabies-infected animals in Banjarbaru City, South Kalimantan, during 2015–2019. This research employed a descriptive approach with a case series design using secondary surveillance data obtained from the Banjarbaru Veterinary Center and the Food Security, Agriculture, and Fisheries Service. Data on rabies-positive animals, animal bite cases, vaccination records, and incidence rates were analyzed using Microsoft Excel and Quantum Geographic Information System (QGIS) to visualize the distribution patterns of rabies cases. The results showed that 56 positive rabies cases were identified during the observation period, with a continuous increase in cases, particularly during 2018–2019. Spatial analysis indicated that North Banjarbaru and Landasan Ulin Districts were categorized as high-risk areas, with incidence rates of 27 and 22 cases per 100,000 animal-years, respectively. The findings demonstrate that spatial–temporal mapping can support rabies surveillance and assist authorities in determining priority areas for intervention. In conclusion, strengthening vaccination programs, animal population control, surveillance systems, and integrated One Health-based strategies are necessary to reduce rabies transmission and support sustainable rabies elimination efforts in Banjarbaru City.

In conclusion, strengthening vaccination programs, animal population control, surveillance systems, and integrated One Health-based strategies are necessary to reduce rabies transmission and support sustainable rabies elimination efforts in Banjarbaru City.

papers.title: LABORATORY CONFIRMATION OF PARALYTIC RABIES IN A 2-YEAR-OLD INDIGENOUS DOG IN SOKOTO, NIGERIA: A CASE REPORT
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease caused by the rabies virus (RABV) that affects the central nervous system of mammals. Despite being preventable, it remains endemic in Nigeria due to low vaccination coverage, a large population of free-roaming dogs, and weak surveillance systems. This report describes a laboratory-confirmed case of paralytic (dumb) rabies in a 2-year-old indigenous dog in Sokoto State, Nigeria. The dog presented with excessive salivation, hyperesthesia, progressive flaccid paralysis, dehydration, anorexia, and inability to vocalize. There was no history of rabies vaccination. The animal had bitten a human unprovoked prior to presentation and died within 48 hours of admission to quarantine. Brain tissue samples were tested at the National Veterinary Research Institute using the direct fluorescent antibody test (DFAT), which demonstrated characteristic apple-green fluorescence confirming rabies infection. Following confirmation, exposed individuals were referred for post-exposure prophylaxis, and public health authorities initiated community sensitization and targeted dog vaccination. This case highlights persistent gaps in rabies control in Nigeria, particularly inadequate vaccination coverage and limited diagnostic decentralization. Strengthening surveillance systems, expanding diagnostic capacity, and sustaining mass dog vaccination within a One Health framework are essential to achieving the goal of eliminating dog-mediated human rabies by 2030.

papers.title_zh: 尼日利亚索科托一只 2 岁本土狗患有瘫痪 狂犬病 的实验室证实:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease caused by the rabies virus (RABV) that affects the central nervous system of mammals. Despite being preventable, it remains endemic in Nigeria due to low vaccination coverage, a large population of free-roaming dogs, and weak surveillance systems. This report describes a laboratory-confirmed case of paralytic (dumb) rabies in a 2-year-old indigenous dog in Sokoto State, Nigeria. The dog presented with excessive salivation, hyperesthesia, progressive flaccid paralysis, dehydration, anorexia, and inability to vocalize. There was no history of rabies vaccination. The animal had bitten a human unprovoked prior to presentation and died within 48 hours of admission to quarantine. Brain tissue samples were tested at the National Veterinary Research Institute using the direct fluorescent antibody test (DFAT), which demonstrated characteristic apple-green fluorescence confirming rabies infection. Following confirmation, exposed individuals were referred for post-exposure prophylaxis, and public health authorities initiated community sensitization and targeted dog vaccination. This case highlights persistent gaps in rabies control in Nigeria, particularly inadequate vaccination coverage and limited diagnostic decentralization. Strengthening surveillance systems, expanding diagnostic capacity, and sustaining mass dog vaccination within a One Health framework are essential to achieving the goal of eliminating dog-mediated human rabies by 2030.

papers.title: Monoclonal antibody therapy for rabies disease: long term impact on central nervous system recovery 2257695
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Lyssaviruses are the causative agent for rabies, a disease that is uniformly fatal in humans without post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Once infection reaches the central nervous system (CNS), PEP is no longer effective. Using a mouse model of lethal rabies disease, we previously demonstrated that peripheral administration of a single dose of neutralizing human monoclonal antibody (mAb), A6, which targets the viral glycoprotein, is highly effective at protecting against lethality. Notably, A6 is effective even when administered following robust replication of virus in the CNS. Moreover, A6 is effective at reducing or even fully reversing multiple signs of disease, including weight loss and limb paralysis. Methods Motor function analyses demonstrated improved motor function of infected A6-treated animals compared to infected untreated controls during the acute phase of disease, but significant impairment compared to uninfected control animals over the post-recovery phase, even months post-treatment. In this study, we perform immunohistochemistry on tissue samples collected at multiple time points post-infection to investigate the underlying mechanisms that may account for failure to completely recover motor function. Results Via stains for inflammatory markers of blood brain barrier (BBB) integrity, initial findings suggest diminished BBB function in both infected untreated animals and infected A6-treated animals. Conclusion These findings corroborate previous data that have suggested structural damage to the CNS, and further suggest that elements of this damage may be beyond repair, despite rescue from mortality and partial functional recovery. Funding Source NIH, DoD USUHS Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the long-term impact of monoclonal antibody therapy on CNS recovery in a mouse model of rabies. While the antibody A6 effectively prevents mortality and improves acute-phase motor function, it does not fully restore long-term neurological function. Immunohistochemistry reveals persistent blood-brain barrier dysfunction, suggesting irreversible CNS damage. The findings underscore the need for therapies targeting irreversible neurological sequelae in rabies survivors.

papers.title_zh: 狂犬病 疾病的单克隆抗体疗法:对中枢神经系统恢复的长期影响 2257695
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Lyssaviruses are the causative agent for rabies, a disease that is uniformly fatal in humans without post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Once infection reaches the central nervous system (CNS), PEP is no longer effective. Using a mouse model of lethal rabies disease, we previously demonstrated that peripheral administration of a single dose of neutralizing human monoclonal antibody (mAb), A6, which targets the viral glycoprotein, is highly effective at protecting against lethality. Notably, A6 is effective even when administered following robust replication of virus in the CNS. Moreover, A6 is effective at reducing or even fully reversing multiple signs of disease, including weight loss and limb paralysis. Methods Motor function analyses demonstrated improved motor function of infected A6-treated animals compared to infected untreated controls during the acute phase of disease, but significant impairment compared to uninfected control animals over the post-recovery phase, even months post-treatment. In this study, we perform immunohistochemistry on tissue samples collected at multiple time points post-infection to investigate the underlying mechanisms that may account for failure to completely recover motor function. Results Via stains for inflammatory markers of blood brain barrier (BBB) integrity, initial findings suggest diminished BBB function in both infected untreated animals and infected A6-treated animals. Conclusion These findings corroborate previous data that have suggested structural damage to the CNS, and further suggest that elements of this damage may be beyond repair, despite rescue from mortality and partial functional recovery. Funding Source NIH, DoD USUHS Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 狂犬病病毒是 暴露后预防 的病原体,这种疾病在没有 暴露后预防 (PEP) 的人类中均是致命的。一旦感染到达中枢神经系统 (CNS),PEP 就不再有效。我们之前使用致命性 狂犬病 疾病的小鼠模型证明,外周注射单剂量的中和人单克隆抗体 (mAb) A6(靶向病毒糖蛋白)可非常有效地防止致命。值得注意的是,即使在病毒在中枢神经系统中剧烈复制后施用,A6 仍然有效。此外,A6 可有效减少甚至完全逆转多种疾病迹象,包括体重减轻和肢体瘫痪。方法运动功能分析表明,在疾病急性期,与感染的未治疗对照动物相比,感染 A6 治疗的动物的运动功能有所改善,但在恢复后阶段,甚至在 治疗 后几个月,与未感染的对照动物相比,运动功能显着受损。在这项研究中,我们对感染后多个时间点收集的组织样本进行免疫组织化学分析,以研究可能导致运动功能无法完全恢复的潜在机制。结果通过对血脑屏障 (BBB) 完整性的炎症标记物进行染色,初步结果表明,受感染的未治疗动物和受感染的 A6 治疗动物的 BBB 功能均减弱。结论 这些发现证实了先前的数据,表明中枢神经系统存在结构性损伤,并进一步表明,尽管经过 死亡率 的抢救且部分功能恢复,但这种损伤的某些部分可能无法修复。资金来源 NIH、DoD USUHS 主题类别 疫苗 和免疫治疗 (VAC)

papers.title: Using Lateral Flow Devices to Enhance Molecular Epidemiology and Evaluating the Rabies Surveillance System on Unguja Island, Zanzibar
papers.abstract: Dog rabies remains a neglected tropical disease in many resource-limited endemic regions, including Unguja Island, Zanzibar. Classically, in such resource-limited settings, an underestimation of the impact of rabies, which directly correlates with insufficient diagnostic capabilities and surveillance efforts, leads to poor investment in effective rabies control. This study combined molecular epidemiology with retrospective analyses of surveillance data from 2016 to 2024 to better understand the transmission dynamics and assess the effectiveness and reliability of the rabies surveillance system on Unguja Island. Towards this goal, rabies RNA was extracted from used lateral flow devices for further molecular phylogenetic analyses of the partial nucleoprotein gene. From this analysis, we were able to conclude that the rabies lyssaviruses presently circulating on Unguja Island represent a distinct endemic cycle in comparison to rabies viruses from elsewhere in Tanzania. In addition, space–time analysis and the evaluation of testing rates identified high-risk rabies areas with particularly inadequate surveillance. These findings allow better understandings of the disease’s impact, which will support improved surveillance and the implementation of targeted control strategies, and will pave the way for, hopefully, the elimination of dog rabies in the longer run.

This study combined molecular epidemiology with retrospective analyses of surveillance data from 2016 to 2024 to better understand the transmission dynamics and assess the effectiveness and reliability of the rabies surveillance system on Unguja Island. Towards this goal, rabies RNA was extracted from used lateral flow devices for further molecular phylogenetic analyses of the partial nucleoprotein gene. From this analysis, we were able to conclude that the rabies lyssaviruses presently circulating on Unguja Island represent a distinct endemic cycle in comparison to rabies viruses from elsewhere in Tanzania. In addition, space–time analysis and the evaluation of testing rates identified high-risk rabies areas with particularly inadequate surveillance. These findings allow better understandings of the disease’s impact, which will support improved surveillance and the implementation of targeted control strategies, and will pave the way for, hopefully, the elimination of dog rabies in the longer run.

papers.title: A hospital-based cross-sectional study on animal bite wound cases in the rural block of Khurda district
papers.abstract: Background: Rabies remains a major public health concern in India, accounting for 36% of global rabies deaths. This study evaluates animal bite wound management practices at Community Health Center (CHC) Mendhasal, Khurda district. Objective of the study was to describe the socio-clinical profile of animal bite wound cases, assess anti-rabies prophylaxis modalities, and recommend improvements. Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 120 randomly selected animal bite cases registered at CHC Mendhasal from December 2023 to March 2024. Data were collected via telephonic interviews using a validated questionnaire. Results: Most victims were male (78%) and adults (>18 years: 64.2%). Dog bites (91%) and unprovoked attacks (68%) were predominant. All category III cases received RIG. However, 17% used plant products on wounds, and 33% of bleeding wounds were misclassified as category II. Conclusions: While vaccination coverage was high, gaps in wound classification and harmful first aid practices persist. Training and community awareness are essential to achieve zero rabies deaths by 2030.
papers.journal: International Journal of Community Medicine and Public Health

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2023 年 12 月至 2024 年 3 月在 CHC Mendhasal 登记的 120 例随机选择的动物咬伤病例进行了描述性横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用经过验证的问卷通过电话访谈收集数据。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要改进伤口分类和社区教育,以减少印度农村地区的 狂犬病 死亡。

papers.title: Molecular Evidence of Canine Distemper Virus Circulation in Red Foxes and Golden Jackals from Western Romania
papers.abstract: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a highly contagious multi-host pathogen that poses a significant threat to both domestic and wild carnivore populations. The increasing overlap between wildlife habitats, peri-urban environments, and domestic animal populations has raised concerns regarding the epidemiological role of wild canids in maintaining and disseminating CDV. This study investigated the occurrence of CDV infection among free-ranging wild canids from western Romania. Brain tissue samples collected from 64 free-ranging wild canids, including 38 red foxes (Vulpes vulpes) and 26 golden jackals (Canis aureus), were initially screened using a commercial immunochromatographic antigen detection assay. Positive samples were subsequently subjected to molecular confirmation by real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). CDV antigen was detected in 16 of the 64 investigated animals (antigen-positive proportion: 25.0%), including 12 red foxes (31.6%) and 4 golden jackals (15.4%). All antigen-positive samples were subsequently confirmed by RT-qPCR, demonstrating the presence of CDV RNA in the screened-positive subset. Since molecular testing was performed only on antigen-positive samples, these proportions should not be interpreted as molecular prevalence estimates. Viral RNA was confirmed in all antigen-positive samples by RT-qPCR, providing molecular evidence of CDV infection in opportunistically sampled wild canids. Although a higher antigen-positive proportion was observed in red foxes, no statistically significant association was identified between host species and CDV positivity (χ2 = 2.16, p = 0.142). These findings provide molecular confirmation of CDV infection in opportunistically collected rabies-negative wild canid carcasses from western Romania. Although the study demonstrates the presence of CDV in both investigated species, the sampling strategy does not allow estimation of population-level occurrence or broader epidemiological inference. Continuous molecular surveillance integrating wildlife, domestic animals, and environmental monitoring is warranted to improve understanding of CDV epidemiology and transmission dynamics in southeastern Europe within a One Health framework.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 犬瘟热病毒(CDV)是一种高度传染性的多 宿主 病原体,对家养和野生食肉动物种群构成重大威胁。野生动物栖息地、城郊环境和家畜种群之间日益重叠的现象引起了人们对野生犬科动物在维持和传播 CDV 方面的流行病学作用的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了罗马尼亚西部自由放养的野生犬科动物中 CDV 感染的发生情况。脑组织样本采集自 64 只自由放养的野生犬科动物,包括 38 只红狐 (Vulpes vulpes) 和 26 只金豺 (Canis aureus)。
elements_zh.methods: 脑组织样本最初使用商业免疫层析抗原检测方法进行筛选。随后通过实时逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)对阳性样本进行分子确认。
elements_zh.main_results: 64只调查动物中有16只检测到CDV抗原(抗原阳性比例:25.0%),其中红狐12只(31.6%)和金豺4只(15.4%)。随后通过 RT-qPCR 确认所有抗原阳性样本,证明筛选的阳性子集中存在 CDV RNA。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为从罗马尼亚西部机会性收集的 狂犬病 阴性野生犬科动物尸体中的 CDV 感染提供了分子证实。尽管在红狐中观察到较高的抗原阳性比例,但在 宿主 物种和 CDV 阳性之间没有发现统计学上显着的关联(χ2 = 2.16,p = 0.142)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 整合野生动物、家畜和环境监测的连续分子 监测 有助于在 One Health 框架内提高对东南欧 CDV 流行病学 和 传播 动态的了解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于分子检测仅对抗原阳性样本进行,因此这些比例不应被解释为分子 患病率 估计值。抽样策略不允许估计人群水平的发生率或更广泛的流行病学推断,限制了研究结果的普遍性。

papers.title: CD40+ MHC-II+ astrocytes promote Th17 cell-driven CNS autoimmunity 2257206
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Astrocyte subsets contribute to the pathology of multiple neurologic disorders, including the T cell driven autoimmune disease of the central nervous system (CNS) multiple sclerosis (MS) and its mouse model, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE). However, little is known about the functional interactions of astrocytes with CD4+ T cells. Methods We used rabies barcode interaction detection followed by sequencing (RABID-seq), in combination with single-cell RNA sequencing, in vitro co-culture systems, and cell-specific in vivo CRISPR—Cas9-based genetic perturbation studies to identify and define a subset of astrocytes that interact with T cells during EAE. Furthermore, We harnessed universal Labeling Immune Partnerships by SorTagging Intercellular Contacts (uLIPSTIC) to analyze astrocyte-interacting CD4+ T cells. Results We identified a subset of astrocytes that expresses CD40 and MHC-II, which promotes CNS-targeting T cell autoimmunity. By harnessing uLIPSTIC to analyze astrocyte-interacting CD4+ T cells, we found that direct astrocyte-CD4+ T cell interactions promote Th17 responses in EAE. Moreover, the genetic inactivation of CD40+ MHC-II+ antigen presenting astrocytes ameliorates EAE. In addition, by applying in vivo subproteomic approaches and AlphaFold-Multimer predictions, we established that CD40 activation in astrocytes by CD40L expressed by T cells induces the accumulation of PLIN4-positive lipid droplets (LDs), which provide acetyl-CoA to boost acetylation-driven NF-kB activation and antigen presentation. Finally, we detected CD40+ MHC-II+ LD+ astrocytes in CNS with MS by snRNA-seq and immunohistochemistry. Conclusion In summary, these studies define an astrocyte subset that promotes Th17-driven CNS autoimmunity. These findings may guide novel therapeutic approaches for MS and other neurologic diseases. Funding Source Human Frontier Science Program long-term postdoctoral fellowship Topic Categories Neuroimmunology (NEUR)

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the functional interactions of astrocytes with CD4+ T cells in the context of CNS autoimmunity, particularly in multiple sclerosis (MS) and its mouse model, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using a combination of in vitro co-culture systems, single-cell RNA sequencing, and in vivo CRISPR-Cas9-based genetic perturbation studies in the EAE mouse model. The research focused on astrocytes and CD4+ T cells in the CNS.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed RABID-seq, single-cell RNA sequencing, in vitro co-culture systems, and CRISPR-Cas9-based genetic perturbation studies to identify and define a subset of astrocytes that interact with T cells during EAE. They also used uLIPSTIC to analyze astrocyte-interacting CD4+ T cells.
analysis.main_results: The study identified a subset of astrocytes that express CD40 and MHC-II, which promotes CNS-targeting T cell autoimmunity. Direct astrocyte-CD4+ T cell interactions were found to promote Th17 responses in EAE.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal a novel mechanism by which CD40+ MHC-II+ astrocytes drive Th17 cell responses in CNS autoimmunity, offering insights into the pathogenesis of MS and similar diseases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of targeted therapies for MS and other neurologic diseases by highlighting the role of CD40+ MHC-II+ astrocytes in promoting autoimmunity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to the EAE mouse model and does not include human data, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on animal models and in vitro systems.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of CD40+ MHC-II+ astrocytes in promoting Th17 cell-driven CNS autoimmunity, using the EAE mouse model. The research identifies a specific astrocyte subset that interacts with CD4+ T cells and contributes to autoimmune responses. By employing advanced techniques such as RABID-seq and uLIPSTIC, the study reveals that these astrocytes enhance antigen presentation and NF-kB activation through lipid droplet accumulation. The findings suggest a potential therapeutic target for MS and other neurologic diseases, though the results are based on animal models and may not fully translate to human conditions. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on in vitro and animal-based experiments, and it highlights the need for further research in human systems.

papers.title: Double positive (DP) developing thymocytes regulate the development of neuronal cell bodies within the thymus 2260542
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Peripheral nervous system innervation of various organs has been associated with the development and maintenance of the immune system. Yet, the intricate details of thymic innervation remain less well-studied. Interestingly, various neurological insults including brain tumors, and neurotropic infections have been shown to have profound impacts on thymic size and cellularity and T cell development. Methods We used flow cytometry, confocal microscopy, neuro tracers, and genetic knockout mice to evaluate developing T cell-neuron interactions within the thymus. Results We have identified neuronal cell bodies within the thymus. These cells express neuronal markers such as NeuN and tyrosine hydroxylase and lack TEC identifiers, such as EpCAM, UEA-1, and Ly51. Thymic neurons can be infected with a neurotropic rabies vector, further cementing their neuronal identity. Considering the thymus consists mostly of T cells, we next investigated a potential interaction between T cells and thymic neurons. Interestingly, loss of T cell development results in a lack of thymic neuron development indicating T cell-neuron coregulation during development. However, thymic neurons can be recovered following a bone marrow transplant, suggesting the provision of a differentiation and/or survival signal for neurons provided by the developing T cells. Using knockout mice lacking the T cell lineage at various stages of development, we determined that TCR beta selection is required for the development of thymic neurons. Finally, we determined that a lack of transition from DN4 to DP severely diminishes the development of thymic neurons. Analysis of the publicly available bulk RNA-sequencing data comparing thymic DP to DN cell populations indicates the potential involvement of IL34 in neuronal development in the thymus. Conclusion We describe a novel population of neuronal cells within the thymus that interact with developing thymocytes to establish optimal thymic architecture. Funding Source NIH K99/R00 Topic Categories Neuroimmunology (NEUR)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the interaction between developing T cells and neuronal cell bodies within the thymus. Using flow cytometry, confocal microscopy, neuro tracers, and genetic knockout mice, the researchers identified a novel population of neuronal cells expressing NeuN and tyrosine hydroxylase. They found that T cell development, specifically TCR beta selection and the DN4 to DP transition, is crucial for thymic neuron development. The study suggests that thymocytes provide signals for neuronal differentiation and survival, highlighting a previously unrecognized neuroimmune interaction in the thymus. These findings could have implications for understanding how neurological conditions impact immune development.

papers.title_zh: 双阳性 (DP) 发育中的胸腺细胞调节胸腺内神经元细胞体的发育 2260542
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Peripheral nervous system innervation of various organs has been associated with the development and maintenance of the immune system. Yet, the intricate details of thymic innervation remain less well-studied. Interestingly, various neurological insults including brain tumors, and neurotropic infections have been shown to have profound impacts on thymic size and cellularity and T cell development. Methods We used flow cytometry, confocal microscopy, neuro tracers, and genetic knockout mice to evaluate developing T cell-neuron interactions within the thymus. Results We have identified neuronal cell bodies within the thymus. These cells express neuronal markers such as NeuN and tyrosine hydroxylase and lack TEC identifiers, such as EpCAM, UEA-1, and Ly51. Thymic neurons can be infected with a neurotropic rabies vector, further cementing their neuronal identity. Considering the thymus consists mostly of T cells, we next investigated a potential interaction between T cells and thymic neurons. Interestingly, loss of T cell development results in a lack of thymic neuron development indicating T cell-neuron coregulation during development. However, thymic neurons can be recovered following a bone marrow transplant, suggesting the provision of a differentiation and/or survival signal for neurons provided by the developing T cells. Using knockout mice lacking the T cell lineage at various stages of development, we determined that TCR beta selection is required for the development of thymic neurons. Finally, we determined that a lack of transition from DN4 to DP severely diminishes the development of thymic neurons. Analysis of the publicly available bulk RNA-sequencing data comparing thymic DP to DN cell populations indicates the potential involvement of IL34 in neuronal development in the thymus. Conclusion We describe a novel population of neuronal cells within the thymus that interact with developing thymocytes to establish optimal thymic architecture. Funding Source NIH K99/R00 Topic Categories Neuroimmunology (NEUR)
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 介绍 各种器官的周围神经系统神经支配与免疫系统的发育和维持有关。然而,胸腺神经支配的复杂细节仍然没有得到充分研究。有趣的是,包括脑肿瘤和嗜神经感染在内的各种神经损伤已被证明对胸腺大小、细胞结构和 T 细胞发育具有深远影响。方法我们使用流式细胞术、共聚焦显微镜、神经示踪剂和基因敲除小鼠来评估胸腺内正在发育的 T 细胞-神经元相互作用。结果我们已经鉴定出胸腺内的神经元细胞体。这些细胞表达 NeuN 和酪氨酸羟化酶等神经元标记,但缺乏 EpCAM、UEA-1 和 Ly51 等 TEC 标识符。胸腺神经元可以被嗜神经 狂犬病 媒介 感染,进一步巩固其神经元身份。考虑到胸腺主要由 T 细胞组成,我们接下来研究了 T 细胞和胸腺神经元之间的潜在相互作用。有趣的是,T 细胞发育的丧失导致胸腺神经元发育缺乏,表明发育过程中 T 细胞-神经元的共同调节。然而,胸腺神经元可以在骨髓移植后恢复,这表明发育中的 T 细胞为神经元提供了分化和/或存活信号。使用在不同发育阶段缺乏 T 细胞谱系的基因敲除小鼠,我们确定胸腺神经元的发育需要 TCR β 选择。最后,我们确定缺乏从 DN4 到 DP 的过渡会严重削弱胸腺神经元的发育。对胸腺 DP 与 DN 细胞群进行比较的公开批量 RNA 测序数据的分析表明,IL34 可能参与胸腺神经元发育。结论 我们描述了胸腺内的一个新的神经元细胞群,它们与发育中的胸腺细胞相互作用以建立最佳的胸腺结构。资金来源 NIH K99/R00 主题类别 神经免疫学 (NEUR)

In 1996, a new strain of rabies in wild raccoons was introduced into northeastern Ohio from Pennsylvania. To protect Ohioans and their domestic animals, the Ohio Department of Health (ODH) and other state and local agencies partnered with the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service Wildlife Services to implement a program to immunize wild raccoons for rabies using an oral rabies vaccine (ORV). This effort created a barrier of immune animals that reduced animal cases and prevented the spread of raccoon rabies into the rest of Ohio. The vaccine-laden baits are dropped by fixed wing aircraft in rural areas and by low-flying helicopters and ground vehicles in urban and suburban neighborhoods. If you have found a bait or have questions, call the Ohio Department of Health Rabies Information Line at (888) 574-6656. Although placement is targeted to raccoon habitat, it is inevitable that some baits may end up in a yard or be found by a pet or person. Dogs, in particular, are attracted to them. Please refer to the information below if you or your pet finds a bait. Expand All Sections Where does baiting occur? The 2026 fall operation will take place Aug. 7 through Aug. 24, 2026, contingent on weather. Baiting will take place in Ashtabula, Belmont, Carroll, Columbiana, Harrison, Jefferson, Mahoning, and Trumbull counties, including the cities of Ashtabula, Belle Vista/Austintown, Boardman, Conneaut, Geneva, Hubbard, Lisbon, Niles, Poland, Struthers, Warren, and Youngstown. For updates and access to near real-time data for the national baiting operation, please visit the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA)'s Daily Status dashboard. One type of bait will be used for the 2026 fall operation: The ONRAB® vaccine is enclosed in a 1" x 2" blister pack filled with the vaccine and covered with a sweet-smelling dark green waxy coating. The baits contain a rabies vaccine that if consumed by a raccoon should vaccinate the animal against the rabies virus. ONRAB® does not contain rabies virus but contains a gene from the rabies virus that causes raccoons and skunks that come in contact with the vaccine to produce antibodies that protect them against rabies infection. Ohio is one of seven states using ONRAB® for baiting operations in the U.S. What if my pet eats the bait? click to expand Ingesting the vaccine will not harm your pet, although eating a large number may temporarily cause vomiting or diarrhea. It is recommended to contact a veterinarian as a precaution if a pet has consumed the vaccine baits. Do not attempt to remove a bait from your pet's mouth – doing so may put you at risk of being bitten. Confine your pet for a couple of days and check the area for more baits. If you find a bait, leave it undisturbed where you found it, unless found in your lawn, driveway, or other area where your pet may find it. Baits can be moved, using gloves, to another location that is less accessible to people or pets where raccoons are more likely to find it. Most baits are gone within four days. Try to avoid your pet's saliva for 24 hours, and wash skin or wounds that may have been licked. Vaccination of your pets remains critical to prevent rabies. The oral rabies vaccine bait is intended for oral vaccination of wildlife only. Consult with a veterinarian about vaccination options for your pets. What if I find a rabies bait? click to expand Baits should be left undisturbed, but intact baits can be moved if they are found in your lawn, driveway, or other area where children and pets may find it. Damaged baits should be bagged and disposed in the trash. Wear gloves or use a paper towel when picking up the bait. Toss intact baits into a fence row, woodlot, ditch, or other raccoon habitat area. Wash your hands well with soap and water after any skin contact with damaged baits. Contact with intact baits is not harmful. Persons who are immunocompromised or pregnant should contact a physician if the bait ruptures and vaccine gets into a mucous membrane or open wound. If a person is exposed to the vaccine (liquid) within the bait, thoroughly wash any areas of the exposed skin with soap and warm water. How are the baits distributed? click to expand Working with employees from cooperating agencies, USDA Wildlife Services distributes baits in urban area and suburban areas by vehicle or helicopter. In rural and open areas, the baits are distributed by aircraft. Can I get rabies from contact with the vaccine? click to expand No. The vaccines do not contain the live rabies virus but contains a gene from the rabies virus that causes raccoons and skunks that come in contact with the vaccine to produce antibodies that protect them against rabies infection. How does a raccoon, skunk, fox, or coyote get vaccinated by eating the ORV bait? click to expand The vaccine is contained inside a blister packet, which is made attractive to wildlife with a sweet attractant. When an animal bites into the bait, it punctures the blister pack and the vaccine bathes the oral cavity and tonsils, resulting in an oral vaccination against rabies. The animal's immune system is exposed to the part of the rabies virus that causes an immune response and production of antibodies against rabies, but the vaccine cannot cause rabies. The blueprint for making antibodies to neutralize the rabies virus is stored in the animal's immune system, allowing it to respond quickly if it is later exposed to a rabid animal. Damaged baits should be bagged and disposed in the trash. Wear gloves or use a paper towel when picking up the bait. Toss intact baits into a fence row, woodlot, ditch, or other raccoon habitat area. Wash your hands well with soap and water after any skin contact with damaged baits. Contact with intact baits is not harmful. Persons who are immunocompromised or pregnant should contact a physician if the bait ruptures and vaccine gets into a mucous membrane or open wound. If a person is exposed to the vaccine (liquid) within the bait, thoroughly wash any areas of the exposed skin with soap and warm water. How are the baits distributed? click to expand Working with employees from cooperating agencies, USDA Wildlife Services distributes baits in urban area and suburban areas by vehicle or helicopter. In rural and open areas, the baits are distributed by aircraft. Can I get rabies from contact with the vaccine? click to expand No. The vaccines do not contain the live rabies virus but contains a gene from the rabies virus that causes raccoons and skunks that come in contact with the vaccine to produce antibodies that protect them against rabies infection. How does a raccoon, skunk, fox, or coyote get vaccinated by eating the ORV bait? click to expand The vaccine is contained inside a blister packet, which is made attractive to wildlife with a sweet attractant. When an animal bites into the bait, it punctures the blister pack and the vaccine bathes the oral cavity and tonsils, resulting in an oral vaccination against rabies. The animal's immune system is exposed to the part of the rabies virus that causes an immune response and production of antibodies against rabies, but the vaccine cannot cause rabies. The blueprint for making antibodies to neutralize the rabies virus is stored in the animal's immune system, allowing it to respond quickly if it is later exposed to a rabid animal. A disproportionate number of people in jails and prisons have chronic medical or behavioral health conditions. When people leave jail, it’s a unique moment to connect them to services in the community that they may not have known about before. Maliha, a social worker in the Jail Health Release Program, shares about what she does to help people with a range of health conditions as they transition out of incarceration. This is near Parrington Lawn, on the University of Washington campus, and is a busy area with many businesses. Anyone who might have had physical contact with this bat (even if not bitten) could be at risk and should seek medical evaluation immediately or call Public Health at 206-296-4774 to determine if rabies preventative treatment is necessary. We talked with Ann Shen, the lead for foodborne and enteric disease investigations for Public Health – Seattle & King County, about the local situation.
